'''Murne Rin''' was a [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. She was a master covert intelligence agent who at one point in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] joined [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] agent, [[Davith Elso/Legends|Davith Elso]] on a mission to [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]<ref name="Undercover" />
